# Laboratory for Mental Health Mapping (MHM Lab)

> {{ site.description | strip_newlines }} Led by Thomas Wolfers (Principal Investigator), Friedrich Schiller University Jena, Germany.

## Pages
- [Home]({{ site.url }}/): overview of the lab and its four research themes
- [People]({{ site.url }}/people/): current lab members, their roles, research, and degrees
- [Research]({{ site.url }}/research/): foundations, structures, markers, and models of mental health mapping
- [Selected publications]({{ site.url }}/selected/): key papers with summaries (full list on Google Scholar)
- [Teaching]({{ site.url }}/teaching/): courses and a selective seminar at Friedrich Schiller University Jena
- [Community]({{ site.url }}/community/): current contributions (MLCN workshop, ECNP, ELLIS Unit Jena, Digital Academy, DZPG)
- [Values]({{ site.url }}/values/): how the lab works together
- [Join Us]({{ site.url }}/join_us/): positions, theses, internships, and how to apply
- [Moving to Jena]({{ site.url }}/moving_to_jena/): practical guide for people relocating to Jena
- [Use of LLMs]({{ site.url }}/use_LLMs/): the lab's policy on large language models
- [Deutsche Version]({{ site.url }}/de/): every page is also available in German under /de/ (e.g. {{ site.url }}/de/people/)
